qualityBar: Regular-season, sourced first-since / franchise-first / never-before game feats. 20-40 facts.

facts.headline: First reverse natural cycle in Cubs history
facts.notes: HR-3B-2B-1B in that order. Sarah Langs: 5th reverse cycle in the expansion era (since 1961). Wikipedia/SABR: 9th reverse natural cycle in the modern era (since 1900).

facts.headline: First MLB reverse cycle since Rajai Davis in 2016
facts.notes: Langs list since 1961: Fregosi 1968, Luke Scott 2006-07-28, Carlos Gomez 2008-05-07, Davis 2016-07-02, PCA 2026-06-15.

facts.headline: First Cubs cycle in first four PAs since Andre Dawson, 1987
facts.notes: Elias. Also first Cubs cycle since Carson Kelly 2025-03-31; 13th cycle in Cubs history; first MLB cycle of 2026; first MLB cycle since Byron Buxton 2025-07-12.

facts.headline: First Phillies cycle since Weston Wilson, 2024
facts.notes: First career cycle. 11th cycle in Phillies history (10th player; Chuck Klein did it twice). Completed with a 5th-inning triple.

facts.line: 4-5 | 3 HR (2 in the 3rd inning), 6 RBI, 4 R
facts.headline: First teammates to combine for a cycle and 3+ HR since 1932

previous.player: Lou Gehrig (4 HR) and Tony Lazzeri (cycle)

facts.notes: Elias via Sarah Langs. Harper cycled; Schwarber hit 3 HR including two in the 3rd (456 and 457 ft). Schwarber's 5th career 3-HR game; franchise-leading 4th 3-HR game as a Phillie. 4th Phillie with 2 HR in one inning (Turner 2023-08-19, Von Hayes 1985-06-11, Seminick 1949-06-02). 2nd MLB player in 2026 with 2 HR in an inning (after Alvarez 2026-06-12).

facts.line: 4-hit cycle; 2B in 3rd, 1B in 5th, HR and 3B in 7th (No. 9 hitter)
facts.headline: First White Sox cycle since José Abreu, 2017
facts.notes: 7th White Sox cycle. 5th player since 1900 to cycle from the 9-hole. 3rd since 1961 to complete a cycle with two hits in the same inning (Felix Pie 2009-08-14, Jim Ray Hart 1970-07-08). First Canadian cycle since George Kottaras 2011-09-03. AP's later cycle roundup listed July 11; game recaps and Wikipedia use July 10.

facts.headline: First Reds road cycle since Heinie Groh, 1915
facts.notes: 8th cycle in Reds history; first Reds cycle since Elly De La Cruz 2023-06-23 vs Braves. First Reds road cycle since Groh at Wrigley, Game 2 of a DH. Elly also went 4-6 a triple shy of a cycle; would have been first game since 1900 with two cycles.

facts.headline: First Padres 5-single game since Adrián González, 2009
facts.notes: First 5-hit game of Tatis's career. First MLB player in 2026 with 5 singles in a game.

facts.headline: First 5-hit game by a Braves catcher since Johnny Estrada, 2004
facts.notes: First career 5-hit game. First Braves player with 2 HR in a 5-hit game since Ozzie Albies 2021-06-30; only other 21st-century Atlanta 5-hit 2-HR games: Andruw Jones 2006, Gary Sheffield 2003. Riley also had a 2-HR game the same afternoon.

facts.headline: First 3-HR game at T-Mobile Park by a Mariner
facts.notes: Only prior 3-HR game at T-Mobile (opened 1999) was visitor Victor Martinez, CLE, 2004-07-16. First Mariners catcher 3-HR game since manager Dan Wilson 1996-04-11. 13th player in Mariners history with a 3-HR game. Last Mariners 3-HR game anywhere: Dominic Canzone 2025-09-16 at KC. Last Mariners home 3-HR game before this: Edgar Martinez 1999-05-18 at the Kingdome.

facts.headline: First Mariners catcher 3-HR game since Dan Wilson, 1996
facts.notes: First 3-HR game of Raleigh's career. All 3 pulled from the left side.

facts.headline: First Dodger 3-HR walk-off game since Don Demeter, 1959
facts.notes: Elias. First MLB 3-HR game including a walk-off since Jack Suwinski 2022-06-19. MLB.com: first player ever with 5+ R, 4+ H, 3+ HR and a walk-off HR in the same game. Second career 3-HR game for Muncy.

facts.line: 3-5 | 2 HR in the 1st inning (2-run + grand slam), 6 RBI
facts.headline: First player ever with a grand slam and a multi-run HR in the 1st inning
facts.notes: AP/Sportradar. First 2-HR first inning since David Ortiz 2008-08-12. Since RBI became official in 1920, only Alvarez and Ortiz have 2 HR and 6 RBI in a first inning (ESPN Research). 3rd Astro with 2 HR in an inning (Lee May 1974-04-29, Jeff Bagwell 1994-06-24). 8th player with a slam + multi-run HR in one inning; first since Kendrys Morales 2012.

facts.headline: First 2-HR first inning since David Ortiz, 2008
Youngest Tigers 3-HR game since Al Kaline, 1955
facts.notes: Keith 24 years, 305 days. Kaline was 20 years, 119 days. First career 3-HR game. Last Tigers 3-HR game: Kerry Carpenter 2025-06-02 at CWS (short window; the Kaline age mark is the historic one).

facts.headline: Most RBI by a Cub in a game since Sammy Sosa, 2002
facts.notes: Sosa had 9 RBI in 2002; exact Sosa game date not re-checked here. 8 RBI is 2nd-most in MLB history from a No. 9 hitter. Most HRs by a Cubs 9-hole hitter. First Cub with back-to-back multi-HR games since Patrick Wisdom 2021-08-27/28. Cubs scored 23, most in a home game since 1977; 8 team HR tied franchise record then set 2025-07-04.

facts.headline: First Cubs player since 1900 with 3 HR and multiple walks in a game
facts.notes: Sarah Langs: 20th MLB player since 1900 with 3 HR and multiple walks. First career 3-HR game. 2nd Cubs 3-HR game of 2026 after Swanson 2026-07-01.

facts.line: 3-6 | 3 HR, 4 RBI (Cubs 9 HR as a team)
facts.headline: Cubs set franchise record with 9 HR in a game
facts.notes: Broke the 8-HR franchise mark set 2025-07-04 vs STL and matched 2026-07-01 vs SDP. Ties 2nd-most by one MLB team in a game since 1900 (Blue Jays 10 on 1987-09-14). Bregman's 2nd 3-HR game of August.

facts.headline: First career 3-HR game; first Cub to HR in 1st and 2nd then HR again since Soriano, 2007
facts.notes: Not the first Cubs 3-HR game of 2026 (Swanson 07-01, Bregman 08-12). Bleed Cubbie Blue: only subsequent Cub after Soriano 2007 to homer in the 1st and 2nd, then homer again. Player-career first 3-HR.

facts.headline: 2 HR and a triple in one game
facts.notes: Confirmed via MLB Stats API game log and B-R box. MLB.com bio: first MLB 2 HR + 3B since Seiya Suzuki 2024-08-24 at MIA, then PCA himself 2025-04-13 at LAD. Rare combo, but the 2026 game is not a long MLB drought. Same night he passed Billy Williams (42 HR in 1970) for Cubs LHH single-season HR record (44).

facts.headline: First Braves 2-HR, 2-SB game since Ender Inciarte, 2017
facts.notes: 4th Braves player: Chipper Jones 1999, Rafael Furcal 2005, Inciarte 2017, Acuña 2026. Grant McAuley/B-Ref tweet said 23rd player since 1898 — that count conflicts with StatMuse (Soto 2025-08-30, Moniak 2025-09-14, Ohtani 2024-09-19). Do not use the '23rd ever' number. MLB previous on StatMuse: Mickey Moniak 2025-09-14.

facts.line: 9 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 0 BB, 15 K, 95 pitches; faced the minimum
facts.headline: Most K in a Maddux (CGSHO, <100 pitches) since pitch counts tracked (1988)
facts.notes: Broke Skubal's 13-K Maddux. 15 K while facing the minimum tied Erik Bedard 2007-07-07 (Bedard allowed 2 H). First career CG/SHO. First Brewers complete game since Brandon Woodruff 2023-09-11 vs MIA. 104.5 mph: hardest pitch by a starter in the pitch-tracking era (since 2008).

facts.headline: First Brewers complete game since Brandon Woodruff, 2023

facts.line: 9 IP, 5 H, 0 ER, 0 BB, 11 K, 109 pitches
facts.headline: First complete-game shutout since June 5, 2019
facts.notes: First CG in more than seven years (last 2019 with Boston at KC, a 3-hit SHO). 4th career shutout. 17th career CG. Threw 100.1 mph, first 100+ pitch since July 2018.

facts.headline: Youngest Yankee ever with 13 K and 0 BB in a game
facts.notes: Sarah Langs. 25 years, 134 days. Youngest Yankee with 13 K since Al Downing (22y, 359d) on 1964-06-21 vs CWS. First regular-season double-digit K game of his career.

facts.headline: 7.1 scoreless, 12 K, 0 BB at Citizens Bank Park
facts.notes: Confirmed gem from the judge catalog. Career-high remains 13 K on Jun 19. No long-window first-since sourced beyond the outing itself.

facts.headline: 2nd Phillies pitcher since 1900 with 13+ K and 0 BB in a game
facts.notes: Velasquez had a 16-K shutout vs Padres in 2016. Sánchez's 2nd career CGSHO. Exact Velasquez date not re-fetched (widely 2016-04-14).

facts.line: 9 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 3 BB, 12 K, 120 pitches (CGSHO)
facts.headline: First Blue Jays 1-hit CGSHO since Brandon Morrow, 2010
facts.notes: First visiting 1-hit CGSHO at Fenway since Félix Hernández in 2007. First Blue Jays complete game of 2026. No-hit bid broken by Andruw Monasterio double in the 6th.

facts.headline: First Royals 1-hit shutout since Zack Greinke, 2009
facts.notes: 2nd Royals CGSHO of 2026 (Stephen Kolek in May; exact Kolek date not sourced here). First time since 2014 the Royals had multiple pitchers with CGSHOs. Perfect through 5; walk in 6th; single in 7th.

facts.player: Tatsuya Imai / Steven Okert / Alimber Santa
facts.line: Combined no-hitter, 9-0 (Imai 6 IP, Okert 1 IP, Santa 2 IP in MLB debut)
facts.headline: First MLB no-hitter since Sept. 4, 2024

previous.player: Shota Imanaga, Nate Pearson, Porter Hodge

facts.notes: First CG no-hitter still Blake Snell 2024-08-02. First Astros no-hitter since Ronel Blanco 2024-04-01. ESPN/Elias: Santa first pitcher since 1900 to appear in a no-hitter in his MLB debut (Bumpus Jones threw a solo no-hitter in his 1892 debut). MLB.com called it Houston's 18th no-hitter; ESPN said 17th regular-season — treat franchise count as medium.

facts.line: 6 IP, 2 H, 1 ER, 2 BB, 10 K (did not bat)
facts.headline: First regular-season 10-K start as a Dodger
facts.notes: LA Times: matched his 10 K in 2025 NLCS Game 4 vs MIL. First outing in which he did not also bat since 2021. Confirmed from judge catalog. Not a long-window MLB first-since.

facts.line: 9 IP, 2 H, 0 ER, 1 BB, 12 K (first career CGSHO)
facts.headline: First career complete game, in start No. 150
facts.notes: Never pitched into the 9th in first 149 starts. Game time 1:51, fastest in MLB in 2026. Not a long franchise drought (Sánchez CGSHO 2026-05-16).
